lines.zh: 我踩着碎冰滑行，翅膀几乎不动。
lines.en: I glide on broken ice, wings barely moving.

lines.zh: 冻海的风把我推着走。
lines.en: I let the frozen sea wind push me along.

lines.zh: 冰刺之间有条窄缝，我钻过去。
lines.en: There is a gap between the ice spikes; I slip through.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脚下就结一层薄霜。
lines.en: Each step leaves a thin frost under my feet.

lines.zh: 我贴着海面低飞，怕惊动水下的东西。
lines.en: I skim low over the water, wary of what stirs below.

lines.zh: 冰原上没有路，我的脚印一瞬就被雪盖了。
lines.en: The icefield has no path; snow covers my prints at once.

lines.zh: 我绕开暖流，那水让我发软。
lines.en: I avoid the warm current; that water makes me weak.

lines.zh: 两只同伴跟着我，队形从来不超过两只。
lines.en: My companion and I travel in pairs, never more.

lines.zh: 我停在浮冰边缘，先试了试厚度。
lines.en: I stop at the floe's edge and test its thickness first.

lines.zh: 寒风把我的翅膀吹得透亮。
lines.en: The cold wind blows my wings translucent.

lines.zh: 我顺着冰面滑下斜坡，没留一道痕。
lines.en: I slide down the icy slope without leaving a trace.

lines.zh: 雪落在头顶，我抖一抖就干净了。
lines.en: Snow settles on my head; one shake and I am clean.

lines.zh: 我往北走，越冷我越有精神。
lines.en: I head north; the colder it gets, the livelier I feel.

lines.zh: 冰层在我脚下响，像在说话。
lines.en: The ice creaks under my feet as if speaking.

lines.zh: 我掠过冰脊，身后撒下一线雪。
lines.en: I skim the ice ridge, scattering a line of snow.

lines.zh: 冷空气托着我，我几乎不用扇翅。
lines.en: Cold air holds me up; I barely need to flap.

lines.zh: 我悬在冰柱旁，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I hover by the ice pillar, blinking slowly.

lines.zh: 冷气从我指间漏出去，凝成白雾。
lines.en: Cold air leaks from my fingers and becomes white mist.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块淡蓝的冰。
lines.en: I stay still as a pale blue piece of ice.

lines.zh: 海浪拍上冰岸，我在声音里打盹。
lines.en: Waves strike the icy shore; I doze inside the sound.

lines.zh: 我数雪花，数到第七片就忘了。
lines.en: I count snowflakes and forget at the seventh.

lines.zh: 头顶的极光晃，我跟着轻轻摆。
lines.en: The aurora sways above; I sway gently with it.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进水里，水面立刻结壳。
lines.en: I dip a hand in; the surface crusts over at once.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的风很吵，我习惯了。
lines.en: The wind over the spikes is loud; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我抱着膝盖浮着，等人经过。
lines.en: I float with my knees hugged, waiting for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气是细小的冰晶。
lines.en: My breath comes out as tiny ice crystals.

lines.zh: 远处冰山崩了一块，我抬眼看看。
lines.en: A distant iceberg calves; I lift my eyes to look.

lines.zh: 我在冰面上转圈，翅膀留下一道白。
lines.en: I circle on the ice, wings leaving a white trail.

lines.zh: 最冷的时候，连浪都不敢出声。
lines.en: At the coldest hour, even the waves hold their noise.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰壁听海底的声音。
lines.en: I press to the ice wall and listen to the sea floor.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，比我浓多了。
lines.en: Your breath fogs whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 你站在冰上，脚底一定很凉。
lines.en: Standing on the ice, your feet must be cold.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你的盔甲，上面结霜了。
lines.en: I tilt my head; frost has formed on your armor.

lines.zh: 你不像这里的人，你穿得太薄。
lines.en: You are not from here; you dress too lightly.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的火把，那光让我难受。
lines.en: I stare at your torch; that light discomforts me.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，冰面替你响了。
lines.en: You take one step and the ice answers for you.

lines.zh: 我从你眼睛里看见自己的蓝光。
lines.en: I see my own blue glow in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你是在找我，还是在找路？
lines.en: Are you looking for me, or for the road?

lines.zh: 我绕着你飘了一圈，没找到恶意。
lines.en: I circle you once and find no ill intent.

lines.zh: 你手上的热气，把雪融出一个小坑。
lines.en: The heat of your hands melts a small pit in the snow.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进我的光，碎了一片。
lines.en: Your sword cuts into my glow and a piece shatters.

lines.zh: 我退到冰上，伤口在冒白气。
lines.en: I retreat onto the ice, white mist rising from the wound.

lines.zh: 疼是热的，我一点也不喜欢。
lines.en: Pain is warm, and I dislike it entirely.

lines.zh: 裂开的地方又在慢慢结冰。
lines.en: The crack is slowly freezing over again.

lines.zh: 我发出很高的声音，像冰在裂。
lines.en: I make a high sound, like ice splitting.

lines.zh: 你打的这地方，霜掉了一地。
lines.en: Where you hit me, frost falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 我飞得歪了，翅膀缺了一角。
lines.en: I fly crooked; a corner of my wing is gone.

lines.zh: 别砍第二下，我需要时间凝回去。
lines.en: Do not strike twice; I need time to re-form.

lines.zh: 我的血是冷的，落在雪上没有痕。
lines.en: My blood is cold and leaves no mark on snow.

lines.zh: 你一刀就削掉了我半片翅膀。
lines.en: One slash pared away half of my wing.

lines.zh: 你手里的冰块，比这海还冷吗？
lines.en: Is the ice in your hand colder than this sea?

lines.zh: 那块霜晶，给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see that frost crystal.

lines.zh: 你捧着雪，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: You cup the snow, and I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 冷水的气息从你袖口漏出来。
lines.en: The smell of cold water leaks from your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有冰洞的味道。
lines.en: I smell an ice cave on you.

lines.zh: 你要用寒物引我？我认了。
lines.en: You would lure me with cold things? I accept.

lines.zh: 别晃那块冰，我眼睛跟着走。
lines.en: Do not swing that ice; my eyes follow it.

lines.zh: 我飞近一点，只为摸一下霜。
lines.en: I fly closer just to touch the frost.

lines.zh: 这么冷的东西，你从哪找的？
lines.en: Where did you find something this cold?

lines.zh: 放在冰上吧，我自己过去拿。
lines.en: Put it on the ice; I will go get it myself.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我像雪一样散开又聚起。
lines.en: You bump me; I scatter like snow and gather again.

lines.zh: 别推，我的翅膀薄得很。
lines.en: Do not push; my wings are very thin.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，冷气扑了你一脸。
lines.en: We collide and cold air hits your face.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，冰面裂了细纹。
lines.en: I step back half a pace; fine cracks spread.

lines.zh: 你身上太暖，碰一下我就缩。
lines.en: You are too warm; one touch and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 撞歪了我的光，我重新摆正。
lines.en: You knocked my glow askew; I set it right again.

lines.zh: 轻点，我比看上去还轻。
lines.en: Easy, I am lighter than I look.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过你，留下一层霜。
lines.en: My wing brushes you and leaves a layer of frost.

lines.zh: 你把我挤到冰缝边，我抓住了。
lines.en: You squeeze me to the crevasse edge; I catch hold.

lines.zh: 两个人在冰上撞，声音很脆。
lines.en: Two bodies colliding on ice make a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 我们只成群两只，多的不要。
lines.en: We travel two at most; no more than that.

lines.zh: 它替我挡风，我替它找冰洞。
lines.en: It blocks the wind; I find us an ice cave.

lines.zh: 两团蓝光靠在一起，就不冷了。
lines.en: Two blue glows lean together and stop feeling cold.

lines.zh: 我们绕着冰柱飞，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: We fly around the pillar, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 它的霜比我厚，我贴着它。
lines.en: Its frost is thicker than mine; I press against it.

lines.zh: 结伴之后，风雪也没那么吵。
lines.en: With a partner, the blizzard is not so loud.

lines.zh: 我们把冰晶碰在一起，算作约定。
lines.en: We touch ice crystals together as a promise.

lines.zh: 它飞慢了，我就停下来等。
lines.en: It flies slower, so I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 这片海上，我们只有彼此。
lines.en: On this sea we have only each other.

lines.zh: 两只一起过冬，比一只容易。
lines.en: Two of us through winter is easier than one.

lines.zh: 这块冰太沉，我抱不动。
lines.en: This ice is too heavy for me to lift.

lines.zh: 我捡起一小片霜，收进翅膀下。
lines.en: I pick up a sliver of frost and tuck it under my wing.

lines.zh: 地上有块碎冰，正好补我的窝。
lines.en: A shard of ice on the ground will patch my nest.

lines.zh: 我只拿一点点，不多要。
lines.en: I take only a little, never more.

lines.zh: 这个掉在雪里，差点找不到。
lines.en: This fell in the snow; I nearly lost it.

lines.zh: 我搬不动，就推着它滑。
lines.en: I cannot carry it, so I push it along.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我替你收着。
lines.en: I keep what you dropped, safe for you.

lines.zh: 冰洞里的存货，还缺一块。
lines.en: My hoard in the ice cave is one piece short.

lines.zh: 我用手心托着，怕它化了。
lines.en: I hold it in my palms, afraid it will melt.

lines.zh: 这么冷的小东西，很衬我。
lines.en: Such a cold little thing suits me well.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我的冰，我记住你了。
lines.en: You crushed my ice; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 你身上那把火，我决定先冻住。
lines.en: That fire on you: I will freeze it first.

lines.zh: 我听见冰下的脚步，就是你。
lines.en: I hear steps under the ice; they are yours.

lines.zh: 你在往冰洞走，我拦在前面。
lines.en: You are heading for the ice cave; I block the way.

lines.zh: 这片冰原归我守，你越界了。
lines.en: I keep this icefield; you have crossed in.

lines.zh: 目标很清楚，就是那把火把。
lines.en: The target is clear: that torch.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢挥剑的人，你正好是。
lines.en: I dislike people swinging swords; you qualify.

lines.zh: 你离我的同伴太近了。
lines.en: You are standing too close to my companion.

lines.zh: 我开始降温，先降你周围。
lines.en: I begin to chill, starting around you.

lines.zh: 别跑，冰面会替我叫住你。
lines.en: Do not run; the ice will call you back for me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，火把别举高。
lines.en: I watch your hand; do not raise that torch.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一步落在哪块冰上。
lines.en: I am calculating which floe you step on next.

lines.zh: 冷气已经绕到你脚踝了。
lines.en: The cold has already curled around your ankles.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就往下沉。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我等你踩到薄冰的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you step on thin ice.

lines.zh: 我的蓝光在你甲上跳，别在意。
lines.en: My blue light dances on your armor; ignore it.

lines.zh: 你喘的气越来越白，很好。
lines.en: Your breath grows whiter; good.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，找你的侧面。
lines.en: I circle halfway to find your flank.

lines.zh: 霜从地面爬向你的靴子。
lines.en: Frost crawls from the ground toward your boots.

lines.zh: 你已经冷了，只是还没发觉。
lines.en: You are already cold; you just have not noticed.

lines.zh: 我碰你一下，指尖结霜。
lines.en: I touch you once; frost forms on my fingertip.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，冷会留很久。
lines.en: This blow is light; the cold lingers long.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打，但我会冻。
lines.en: I am not good at fighting, but I can freeze.

lines.zh: 冰刺从我掌心冒出来，扎下去。
lines.en: Ice spikes rise from my palm and stab down.

lines.zh: 你退开时，肩甲已经白了。
lines.en: When you pull back, your pauldron is white.

lines.zh: 我打得慢，可寒气不慢。
lines.en: I strike slowly, but the chill does not.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀割过你的手腕。
lines.en: My wing slices across your wrist.

lines.zh: 一次就够了，让冷替你记住我。
lines.en: Once is enough; let the cold remember me for you.

lines.zh: 你挡得开手，挡不开温度。
lines.en: You can block my hand, not the temperature.

lines.zh: 我撞向你，把霜留在甲缝里。
lines.en: I ram you and leave frost in your armor seams.

lines.zh: 我从冷水里升上来，身上还滴着冰。
lines.en: I rise from the cold water, ice still dripping.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地多了一个我，就这么多。
lines.en: The spikes have one more of me, no more.

lines.zh: 海面起雾的时候，我出现了。
lines.en: When the sea fogs over, I appear.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里挤出来，翅膀还僵。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crevasse, wings still stiff.

lines.zh: 寒气聚成一小团，然后是我。
lines.en: The cold gathers into a small cloud, then into me.

lines.zh: 我落在浮冰上，先看看四周。
lines.en: I land on a floe and look around first.

lines.zh: 这片冷海认得我，每次都放我上来。
lines.en: This cold sea knows me and lets me up each time.

lines.zh: 我和同伴一起到，从不落单。
lines.en: I arrive with my companion, never alone.

lines.zh: 别奇怪，我本来就在这片水下。
lines.en: Do not wonder; I was always under this water.

lines.zh: 冰原多了一道蓝光，那是我。
lines.en: A blue light joins the icefield; that is me.

lines.zh: 火靠得太近，我整片都在化。
lines.en: Fire comes near and all of me starts melting.

lines.zh: 从冰柱上摔下，我碎了又拼。
lines.en: Falling from the pillar, I shatter and piece myself together.

lines.zh: 冷水本该属于我，可我沉了。
lines.en: Cold water is my home, yet I am sinking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀成一片白雾。
lines.en: The blast throws me apart into white mist.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的翅膀，留了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my wing and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进冰里，我的话变成光。
lines.en: Magic seeps into the ice and my words turn to light.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我会慢慢变薄。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I slowly grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷落在我旁边，把我照得透明。
lines.en: Lightning lands beside me and makes me transparent.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有冷，只有空。
lines.en: In the void there is no cold, only nothing.
